device._note: Launch Pro. GameChanger auto-discovers and holds this connection itself during play - no clicking needed, it just needs the port free. FSX Pro is for setup/testing only: in its own Settings > Devices, turn OFF 'Auto connect with solo device' (one-time) so it never grabs the port on its own. `reconnect` drives FSX Pro's own connection by hand (wired first, then Wi-Fi) for that testing - it is NOT used by automatic recovery.

projector._note: Projector on = Windows reports a 2nd display. GSPro then goes to the leftmost one, otherwise Display 1. Set match_regex (matched against the monitor's PnP id/name, e.g. "BNQ|EPS|OPT") if a second real monitor is ever attached.

gspro_display._note: Set windowed=false for fullscreen; borderless_when_pip=true helps keep the Always-on-Top OBS Projector PiP cleanly layered over GSPro when Projector PiP is enabled.

video._note: Kinovea 2x2 TV grid (Top: Live DTL+FO auto-replay, Bottom: Pro or My-Go-To reference) + OBS Projector PiP overlay + OpenConnect (:921) shot trigger & file naming.
video._kinovea_note: kinovea_backend: auto (reads Kinovea.exe version: 2025.x -> UDP trigger + clip-ready post-recording command; 2024.1 -> legacy toggle) | 2025 | legacy. capture_root: LOCAL non-OneDrive folder for raw recordings (empty = %LOCALAPPDATA%\SimWatch\Captures). legacy_trigger: toggle | audio. See SETUP-video.md.

bridge._note: Local shot-data bridge for the drills hub: every OpenConnect shot is appended to <sessions_dir>/YYYY-MM-DD/shots.jsonl and served on http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ (127.0.0.1 only unless lan is true).
bridge._lan_note: lan: true = also serve the drills hub to a phone on your home Wi-Fi (binds 0.0.0.0; non-local clients need the pairing token in bridge_token.txt). Get the URL with: python simwatch.py phone. Then run harden --apply for the firewall rule (TCP <port>, Private, LocalSubnet only).

shotlab._note: ShotLab desktop app + OBS overlays (shotlab/). The watchdog launches it once GSPro is up, relaunches it if it crashes or hangs, and leaves it closed if you close it (until the next GSPro session). Supervised separately from 'checks': ShotLab problems never trigger rig recovery. Install once with setup.bat (needs Node.js 20+).

recovery.name: restart GSPro and the chain behind it

device_recovery._note: Used when ONLY device checks fail while the Launch Pro is reachable (GameChanger lost its session). Restarts GameChanger only; waits backoff_sec[n] between attempts (5 -> 15 -> 30 min, last value repeats), reset once the device session is healthy.
device_recovery.name: restart GameChanger (device session only)

startup._note: Order after a reboot. GSPro spawns GSPconnect itself when it starts; gspro_connect is only launched if that didn't happen. GameChanger goes last so GSPro/GSPconnect are already up for its OpenAPI side, and so it (not FSX Pro) claims the Launch Pro connection.
